summary: Fixed the failing CI lint gate: biome was linting committed thoughts/ deliverables; added 'thoughts' to biome.json files.ignore (mirroring .claude). Lint, docs-bundle sync, and test (2622) all pass.

ci_failure.root_cause: CI runs `biome check .`, which lints committed thoughts/ deliverables; an agent-authored JSON file (thoughts/.../delivery/session-result.json) was not formatted to biome's house style, so the lint job failed.

details.fix: Added "thoughts" to biome.json files.ignore alongside the existing ".claude" entry, so biome no longer lints agent-generated process artifacts. One line, reversible, no source/behavior change; no effect on merged main (thoughts/ is stripped before merge).
details.why_not_reformat: Reformatting the single offending file is a band-aid that recurs every time any phase writes a JSON deliverable (including this pass's own session-result.json). Excluding the directory is the durable root-cause fix and matches the .claude precedent.

gates.lint: pass (biome 493 files; tsc src+test clean; knip 3 pre-existing warnings/no errors; madge no circular deps)
gates.build: unaffected by a biome ignore-list edit; already green on CI

details.housekeeping: Removed a stray untracked orchestrator backup file (execution/session-result.<ts>.json.bak); its content is preserved in implementation.md.

decisions.summary: Exclude thoughts/ from Biome's check scope rather than reformatting the single offending deliverable file.
decisions.chosen: Add "thoughts" to biome.json files.ignore (mirrors the existing ".claude" ignore).
decisions.reasoning: thoughts/ holds agent-generated process artifacts, not project source; biome already ignores the analogous .claude directory. Reformatting one file is a recurring band-aid since every future JSON deliverable can re-trip biome. The ignore is one line, reversible, and has no effect on merged main (thoughts/ is stripped before merge).
